title: A Inventory for the Glasshouse
author: Z. M. Iversen
blurb: Freya Amberdale, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has spent ten years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
